question: Which award recognised Kelly Slater for his lifelong contributions to sport in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The legendary surfer **Kelly Slater** was honored with the **Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award** in **April 2025** during the prestigious **Laureus World Sports Awards** ceremony.
 
• This recognition celebrates his unparalleled career and lifelong contributions to the world of **surfing** and global sports, marking him as one of the most influential athletes of his generation.
 
• **Kelly Slater** has secured a record-breaking **11 World Surf League (WSL) titles**, making him the most successful professional surfer in history. ***Hence, the statement regarding the Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award is correct.***
